title: A profile of French software maker ChapsVision, which won a contract to replace Palantir at France's domestic intel agency in June and targets an IPO by 2030 (Adrienne Klasa/Financial Times)
summary: Adrienne Klasa / Financial Times: A profile of French software maker ChapsVision, which won a contract to replace Palantir at France's domestic intel agency in June and targets an IPO by 2030 — ChapsVision pursues defence and intelligence contracts across the region as governments look to reduce reliance on US technology
